answer: Use one-use work ballots with delayed issuance. 1) A key locks 26 POA for 21 days and commits a signed result before a public beacon. 2) The beacon assigns five distinct tasks; three established peers from unrelated payout paths audit randomly chosen outputs. 3) Shared funders, copied traces, or repeated timing merge keys to one ballot; proof of duplication burns half the bond. Faking 1,000 ballots locks 26,000 POA, risks 13,000 POA, and demands 5,000 outputs plus 15,000 checks. Like a plume above cedar on sable soil, one root scents every hidden branch.
